description: Create a new TouchDesigner system container containing an ISF (.fs) shader as a GLSL TOP, companion DATs, and optional live controls. Accepts raw source, a local file path, or an http(s) URL; URL fetches are bounded by fetch_timeout_ms. Returns the container/GLSL/output paths, generated controls, provenance, warnings for inputs that need manual wiring, and an inline preview when capture_preview=true. Use create_glsl_shader for hand-written GLSL or import_shadertoy for Shadertoy sources. Imported shader source requires TDMCP_RAW_PYTHON=on and TDMCP_BRIDGE_ALLOW_EXEC=1.

capture_preview.description: Capture an inline preview after the shader is built; disable for faster headless runs.

channel_overrides.description: Override default placeholder noise for ISF image/audio inputs.

control_defaults.description: Override the ISF DEFAULT for any input at build time.

expose_controls.description: Expose ISF inputs as live custom controls on the generated system container.

fetch_timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds for URL sources; local files and raw source do not need network access.

name.description: System container name (sanitized). Defaults to ISF DESCRIPTION or 'isf_shader'.

pixel_format.description: Pixel format for the generated GLSL TOP.

source.description: ISF (.fs) source: raw shader text, a local file path, or an http(s) URL.

source_kind.description: Override the source sniffer; 'raw' skips IO.

name: import_isf_shader
title: Import ISF shader
